answer: Each submission hangs on the lantern of a task receipt, and the island is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the garden of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, diluted when peers disagree, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
